hold_reason: The ratified WIC decode path has no product process/trust boundary or safety proof, and no product crate calls the decode preflight, so no decode class can be admitted on the product path. Deriving one from the development probe is forbidden by DC-MP-IMG2.

what_exists.fact: decode preflight arithmetic only: DecodeLimits/DecodeBudget/DecodeRequest/DecodeAdmission/admit_decode with checked arithmetic, MAX_SUPPORTED_BIT_DEPTH 16 and MAX_SUPPORTED_CHANNELS 4; the module states it selects no decoder, decodes nothing and owns no GPU object
dependencies are desktop-protocol and sha2 only; no image codec, no windows crate, no FFI
bounded encoded-media cache, digest verification, representation identity and orientation types; no decode call
development-only WIC comparison/probe tooling driven through PowerShell; evidence tooling, not a product path

product_path_evidence.imports_of_media_in_product_crates: none — apps/desktop, crates/desktop-gpui, crates/ui-model and crates/app-core have no `media` import
product_path_evidence.windows_bindings_in_media: none — no wic/windows:: usage in crates/media/src
product_path_evidence.desktop_windows_usage: instance.rs and r0_s2b.rs use std::os::windows::fs only (file identity), unrelated to decoding

routes_and_why_each_is_blocked.route: productise the ratified WIC path through the existing managed WIC/WPF boundary
routes_and_why_each_is_blocked.blocker: this is the ratified direction, not a new decision; what is missing is the product process boundary and its safety proof, which needs its own architecture approval, and in a Rust-native implementation a Windows API boundary that the workspace unsafe_code = forbid currently excludes

routes_and_why_each_is_blocked.route: replace WIC with a third-party decoder crate
routes_and_why_each_is_blocked.blocker: this would change the ADR-0008 §2 decode-path decision, not merely add a dependency, so it needs a superseding design decision before any licence or dependency approval

routes_and_why_each_is_blocked.route: declare an admitted class from the development probe results
routes_and_why_each_is_blocked.blocker: DC-MP-IMG2 requires admission on the product path; a probe success is explicitly not that

acceptance_assessment.AC01_class_named: NOT_MET — no admitted class can be named without a product decoder
acceptance_assessment.AC02_admission_before_materialization: PARTIAL — the arithmetic seam enforces order, but nothing materializes
acceptance_assessment.AC03_conservative_concurrent_bound: NOT_MET — WIC internal scratch is unmeasured and must not be assumed zero
acceptance_assessment.AC05_no_partial_or_stale_publication: NOT_APPLICABLE — nothing is decoded or published
acceptance_assessment.AC06_oversize_corrupt_unsupported_refuse: PARTIAL — preflight refusals exist and are tested; no decoder consumes them
acceptance_assessment.AC09_probe_evidence_not_claimed_as_produ: MET — this record keeps them separate
acceptance_assessment.AC10_tests_and_gate: NOT_RUN for product change — no product source changed, so no Gate applies (ADR-0014 Y04); the existing media tests were not modified

questions: Approve the product process/trust boundary and safety proof that turns the ratified WIC path into a product decoder (no ADR-0008 change, and no Rust unsafe if the boundary stays out of process).
Or explicitly supersede ADR-0008 §2 if a third-party decoder is wanted instead; that decision precedes dependency and licence review.
decision_required.consequence_of_no_decision: MP-IMG2 stays at preflight-only and MP-IMG3 remains blocked because no admitted decoded class exists

mp_img3_readiness: NOT_READY — the prerequisite admitted decode class does not exist
scope_note: This record adds no code, no dependency, no FFI and no contract change. It stops at the first stop condition — the missing product process boundary and safety proof for the ratified WIC path — instead of inventing a decoder, adopting an unapproved third-party decoder or promoting probe evidence.

ratified_boundary.decision: Windows Imaging Component (WIC) through the existing managed WIC/WPF probe boundary is the ratified product decode path; it is not an open choice between unrelated decoders
ratified_boundary.what_is_not_decided: how that probe boundary becomes a product process boundary: its process/trust model, safety proof, failure handling and packaging are not ratified by ADR-0008

review.scope_note: Clean review confirms the HOLD record only; MP-IMG2 is not implemented, no decode class is admitted and MP-IMG3 is NOT_READY.
